gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent World Health Organization (WHO) Grade II Glioma; Low-grade Glioma; High-Grade Glioma (HGG)
or must have a histologically confirmed diagnosis of a high-grade glioma (HGG) (WHO grade III-VI)

candidate_evidence.quote: To estimate the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2D) of trametinib given orally in combination with everolimus in pediatric and young adult patients with gliomas.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Trametinib and Everolimus for Treatment of Pediatric and Young Adult Patients With Recurrent Gliomas (PNOC021)

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Plasma trametinib and everolimus concentration-time data will be analyzed using a classic non-compartmental approach and/or population-based compartmental methods using non-linear mixed effects modeling.

role_evidence.quote: Giving trametinib and everolimus may work better to treat low and high-grade gliomas compared to trametinib or everolimus alone.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: targets MEK and disrupts tumour growth

role_evidence.quote: Giving trametinib and everolimus may work better to treat low and high-grade gliomas compared to trametinib or everolimus alone.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: may block another pathway in tumour cells that can help tumours grow (PI3K/mTOR)

biomarkers.biomarker_other: unspecified predictive biomarkers from comprehensive genomic testing

source_quote.quote: To identify potential predictive biomarkers to targeted therapy in pediatric and young adult patients with LGGs.

coder_notes: Paediatric and young adult trial (stdAges CHILD, ADULT) in recurrent LGG and HGG; glioblastoma is never named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm label, only 'high-grade glioma (HGG) (WHO grade III-VI)', so high_grade_glioma_unspecified. WHO Roman-numeral grading with no IDH reference coded historical. Tissue for comprehensive genomic testing is required for enrolment but no specific alteration is an entry requirement. PK is plasma only. Quantitative MRI measures are imaging-only and not recorded.
